title: bee status --json keeps role descriptions in its models section
action: In status_full/build.rs, where the status JSON inserts the models section (config_models.models, the normalized map), merge each raw slot's description string back onto the normalized slot object for DISPLAY — a described string slot becomes {model, description} in the output; slots without a description stay byte-identical. Internal resolution keeps using the stripped normalized map — only the status output changes. Add tests: a described role shows its description in the status models section; an undescribed config's models section is unchanged from today.

truths: bee status --json models.claude.<role>.description appears when the raw config carries it
A config with no descriptions produces a models section byte-identical to before
normalize_models itself is unchanged — resolution stays blind to the field

verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee status_full — green with the new tests named in the output
notes: PBI p-0a5e6c44 CoS 2. Do not touch drivers/models.rs.
